newsitem.title: UK: February Ekofisk programme 26 cargoes - trade.
newsitem.headline: February Ekofisk programme 26 cargoes - trade.

text.p: Norway's Ekofisk crude oil pipeline system is due to load 26 cargoes in February, down five cargoes from January, trade sources said.
The February programme will consist of 15 cargoes of 500,000 barrels each and a further 11 cargoes of 600,000 barrels each.
Some 16.6 million barrels were loaded in January but February's 14.1 million barrels represents a reduction of around 30,000 barrels per day.
Loadings scheduled under the original January Ekofisk programme have been delayed by around five days, but there are no cancellations, equity holders said on Thursday.
The last of the remaining January cargoes has been given Feb 5-7 loading dates.
First loadings under the February programme, are expected towards the end of the first decade of the month, traders said.
Norway's Ekofisk production in February will be supplemented by crude from the Fulmar fields which is expected to begin flowing into the Norpipe system, which handles Ekofisk, by the end of January.
Fulmar blend will be mixed with Ekofisk output in the Norpipe via a Y-coupling for landing at the Teesside terminal in northeast England.
